import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    df = sns.load_dataset('titanic')

# Create a figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create the pointplot to show survival probability with confidence intervals
sns.pointplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    hue='who',
    palette='viridis',
    markers=['o', 's', 'D'],
    linestyles=['-', '--', ':'],
    ax=ax,
    dodge=True
)

# --- Style and Annotations ---

# Set the title and labels with clear, descriptive text
ax.set_title(
    'Titanic Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Type',
    fontsize=18,
    fontweight='bold',
    pad=20
)
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Survival Probability', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)

# Customize x-axis ticks
ax.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=11)

# Format y-axis as percentage
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

# Improve grid and layout
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='')
sns.despine()

# Enhance the legend
legend = ax.legend(title='Passenger Type', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='11', loc='upper left')
legend.get_frame().set_alpha(0.9)
legend.get_frame().set_facecolor('white')

# Add a background text for context
fig.text(0.5, 0.02,
         'Analysis shows a stark difference in survival rates. Women and children in First Class had the highest chances of survival,\n'
         'while men in Third Class had the lowest, highlighting the era\'s social hierarchy and "women and children first" protocol.',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color='gray', style='italic')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.95]) # Adjust layout to make space for text

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
